title: pterocarpus korthalsianus
intro: Pterocarpus korthalsianus, commonly known as Borneo ironwood, is a species of plant in the family Fabaceae. It is a tree native to Borneo and is valued for its durable and highly prized wood. The health benefits of Pterocarpus korthalsianus include its potential to treat various health conditions, such as fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its bioactive constituents. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids.
